verdict.rationale: Terraform Cloud/Enterprise documents a policy-enforcement feature (Sentinel/OPA-style) that validates plans against security rules and best practices before allowing an apply, which is the core policy-as-code capability a devops-lead would want. However, evidence is a single thin doc reference with no detail on enforcement levels (advisory vs hard-mandatory), no Sentinel/OPA specifics, and no independent or hands-on confirmation that non-compliant changes are actually blocked. missing for 10: detailed docs on enforcement levels and policy language (Sentinel/OPA), hands-on proof of a blocked apply, independent community corroboration of policy gating in practice.
